"""Local coverage experiment: real pixels/labels, grouped development blocks, no product edits."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,copy,random
from collections import Counter
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
import numpy as np,yaml

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OLD=ROOT.parent
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
DATA=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS')
PREP=DATA/'out/coordinate-expanded-study-20261015/training-prep-v1'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(name,obj):(ROOT/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

manifest=read(PREP/'manifest.json');corpus=read(DATA/'out/coordinate-label-expansion-20261015/expanded-corpus-v5.json')
historical=read(SOURCE/'Tests/CoordinateOffline/corpus.json')
# Temporal scene groups describe sampled dominant appearances, not a per-frame semantic classifier.
groups=[('green-yellow-grass',1,379,121,170),('cool-rock-mixed',380,561,461,490),
        ('cool-dark-ground',562,685,601,620),('orange-grass',686,935,761,800),
        ('snow-pale-mixed',936,1160,1041,1080)]
rows=[];membership={};scene={};gap=10
for row in manifest['rows']:
    n=int(row['id'].rsplit('-',1)[1]);matches=[g for g in groups if g[1]<=n<=g[2]]
    assert len(matches)==1,(n,matches)
    name,start,end,lo,hi=matches[0]
    split='development' if lo<=n<=hi else 'purged' if lo-gap<=n<=hi+gap else 'train'
    item=copy.deepcopy(row);item.update(split=split,sceneGroup=name,image=str(PREP/row['image']),historical=False)
    pixels=np.array(Image.open(PREP/row['image']).convert('RGB'))
    item['meanLuma']=float(np.mean(pixels@np.array([.2126,.7152,.0722])))
    rows.append(item);membership[row['id']]=split;scene[row['id']]=name

# Six existing full-XYZ positive-X labels: never rewrite them or promote the XY-only grass frame.
positives=[f for f in historical['frames'] if f['state']=='present' and f['expected']['x']>0 and f['expected']['z'] is not None]
boxes={'laguna':(48,1406,234,1438),'qiqiu':(48,1406,304,1438),'lowervault':(48,1406,234,1438),
       'blackshores':(48,1406,234,1438),'timeriftruins':(48,1406,182,1438),
       'black-shores-gameplay':(36,1053,188,1079)}
(ROOT/'historical-crops').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for frame in positives:
    path=DATA/frame['image'];im=Image.open(path).convert('RGB');box=boxes[frame['id']]
    crop=im.crop(box);target=ROOT/'historical-crops'/f"{frame['id']}.png";crop.save(target)
    exp=frame['expected'];text=','.join(str(exp[k]) for k in 'xyz')
    rows.append({'id':frame['id'],'image':str(target),'text':text,'expected':exp,'split':'train',
                 'sceneGroup':'historical-positive-X','historical':True,'sourceImage':str(path),
                 'sourceSHA256':sha(path),'sourceRect':list(box),'cropSHA256':sha(target),
                 'annotation':frame['annotation'],'geometry':'manual label-informed training crop; not evaluation ROI'})

train=[r for r in rows if r['split']=='train' and not r['historical']]
dev=[r for r in rows if r['split']=='development']
assert all(r['expected']['x']<0 for r in train+dev)
assert len(positives)==6 and len({r['id'] for r in rows})==1017
assert not any(r['id'].endswith('-001100') for r in rows)
for a in train:
    n=int(a['id'].rsplit('-',1)[1])
    assert all(abs(n-int(b['id'].rsplit('-',1)[1]))>gap for b in dev)
def balanced(items,size):
    pool=list(items);rng=random.Random(20261015);rng.shuffle(pool)
    return [pool[i%len(pool)] for i in range(size)]
# Equal scene exposure, plus a fixed-size sign replay slot: both trials have the same update budget.
scene_slots=[r for g in groups for r in balanced([r for r in train if r['sceneGroup']==g[0]],320)]
control=scene_slots+balanced(train,128)
replay=scene_slots+balanced([r for r in rows if r['historical']],128)
assert len(control)==len(replay)==1728
for name,items in [('coverage-only',control),('coverage-positive',replay),('development',dev)]:
    (ROOT/(name+'.txt')).write_text(''.join(r['image'].replace('\\','/')+'\t'+r['text']+'\n' for r in items),encoding='utf-8')
base=yaml.safe_load((OLD/'numeric-runtime-bnfrozen.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for name in ['coverage-only','coverage-positive']:
    c=copy.deepcopy(base);c['Global'].update(save_model_dir=str(ROOT/name).replace('\\','/'),
        save_res_path=str(ROOT/(name+'-predicts.txt')).replace('\\','/'),eval_batch_step=[0,108])
    c['Train']['dataset']['data_dir']=str(ROOT).replace('\\','/')
    c['Train']['dataset']['label_file_list']=[str(ROOT/(name+'.txt')).replace('\\','/')]
    c['Eval']['dataset']['data_dir']=str(ROOT).replace('\\','/')
    c['Eval']['dataset']['label_file_list']=[str(ROOT/'development.txt').replace('\\','/')]
    (ROOT/(name+'.yaml')).write_text(yaml.safe_dump(c,sort_keys=False),encoding='utf-8')

summary=[]
for g in groups:
    part=[r for r in rows if r['sceneGroup']==g[0]]
    summary.append({'group':g[0],'temporalRange':list(g[1:3]),'developmentBlock':list(g[3:5]),
                    'splitCounts':dict(Counter(r['split'] for r in part)),
                    'meanLumaBySplit':{s:float(np.mean([r['meanLuma'] for r in part if r['split']==s])) for s in ['train','development','purged']}})
receipt={'purpose':'coverage and sign replay follow-up; same explored session development, not independent acceptance',
    'previousSplitUnchanged':True,'oldDevelopmentNowPartlyTraining':True,'humanVerifiedNewSessionLabels':False,
    'sceneAssignment':'sampled visual temporal groups; mixed appearances within each group',
    'purgeRawFrames':gap,'groups':summary,'rows':rows,
    'trials':{name:{'entries':len(items),'uniqueImages':len({r['id'] for r in items}),
                    'positiveXEntries':sum(r['expected']['x']>0 for r in items),
                    'sceneEntries':dict(Counter(r['sceneGroup'] for r in items)),
                    'orderedIds':[r['id'] for r in items]}
              for name,items in [('coverage-only',control),('coverage-positive',replay)]},
    'sources':{'captureManifestSHA256':sha(PREP/'manifest.json'),'historicalCorpusSHA256':sha(SOURCE/'Tests/CoordinateOffline/corpus.json')},
    'limitations':['No positive-X examples in the 1011 capture labels.',
        'Six historical positive-X images replayed, not 128 independent images; no positive-X grass/snow full-XYZ samples.',
        'Historical grass has only XY truth; historical snow has no confirmed truth; neither used in training.',
        'New development frames overlap previous experiments; old candidate trained on some new development frames.',
        'Temporal gaps reduce adjacent-frame overlap but do not create independent capture sessions.']}
write('coverage-manifest.json',receipt)
write('development-corpus.json',{**corpus,'frames':[f for f in corpus['frames'] if f['state']!='present' or membership[f['id']]=='development']})
hist_eval=[f for f in historical['frames'] if f['id'] not in {p['id'] for p in positives}]
write('historical-evaluation-corpus.json',{**historical,'frames':hist_eval,'note':'Six positive-X historical frames now training; excluded. Remaining old regressions are not a new independent test.'})
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(650,6*76),'#222');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
for i,r in enumerate([r for r in rows if r['historical']]):
    im=Image.open(r['image']);canvas.paste(im,(5,i*76+24));draw.text((5,i*76+3),f"{r['id']} {r['text']}",fill='white')
canvas.save(ROOT/'historical-training-crop-qa.png')
print(json.dumps({'groups':summary,'trainUnique':len(train),'development':len(dev),
    'purged':sum(r['split']=='purged' for r in rows),'historicalPositiveUnique':6,'entriesPerTrial':1728},indent=2))

export_configs.py.text:
"""Create native-compatible export configurations without editing model metadata by hand."""
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for name in ['coverage-only','coverage-positive']:
    c=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/(name+'.yaml')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    c['Global']['pretrained_model']=str(ROOT/name/'latest').replace('\\','/')
    c['Global']['save_inference_dir']=str(ROOT/(name+'-infer-paddle30')).replace('\\','/')
    c['Global']['d2s_train_image_shape']=[3,48,320]
    # Exported YAML preprocessing is generated from Eval transforms, independently of d2s shape.
    resize=[t['RecResizeImg'] for t in c['Eval']['dataset']['transforms'] if 'RecResizeImg' in t]
    assert len(resize)==1
    resize[0]['image_shape']=[3,48,320]
    (ROOT/(name+'-export-paddle30.yaml')).write_text(yaml.safe_dump(c,sort_keys=False),encoding='utf-8')

"""Replay frozen fixed ROI inputs using existing native CPU adapter; no labels sent to it."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,os,sys,subprocess,importlib.util
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OLD=ROOT.parent
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
DATA=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write=lambda p,o:p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
corpus=read(ROOT/'development-corpus.json');frames={f['id']:f for f in corpus['frames']}
original=DATA/'out/coordinate-line-study-20261015/english-aspect-full/inputs.json'
inputs=[x for x in read(original)['inputs'] if x['sourceId'] in frames and x['profile']=='readout-line']
assert len(inputs)==len(frames)==329
for item in inputs:
    assert 'expected' not in item and 'state' not in item
    assert item['sourceSHA256']==frames[item['sourceId']]['captureSHA256']
    assert sha(Path(item['image']))==item['cropSHA256']
write(ROOT/'replay-inputs.json',{'formatVersion':1,'inputs':inputs})
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchmark',SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr/benchmark.py')
b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
native=SOURCE/'out/build/coordinate-offline/IMaoCoordinateOffline.exe'
models={'initial':OLD/'numeric-runtime-initial-infer-paddle30',
        'previous':OLD/'numeric-runtime-bnfrozen-infer-paddle30',
        'coverage-only':ROOT/'coverage-only-infer-paddle30',
        'coverage-positive':ROOT/'coverage-positive-infer-paddle30'}
env=dict(os.environ);env['PATH']=str(DATA/'x64/Release')+os.pathsep+env.get('PATH','')
for name in sys.argv[1:]:
    folder=models[name];output=ROOT/f'replay-{name}.json'
    assert not output.exists(),f'Preserve existing evidence: {output}'
    before=b.provenance(SOURCE,DATA,ROOT/'development-corpus.json',native,DATA/'third_party/research/WutheringWaves-Navigator',folder)
    command=[str(native),str(folder),str(ROOT/'replay-inputs.json'),str(output),'1','aspect']
    completed=subprocess.run(command,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,errors='replace')
    (ROOT/f'replay-{name}.log').write_text(completed.stdout+completed.stderr,encoding='utf-8')
    assert completed.returncode==0,completed.returncode
    payload=read(output);b.verify_native_provenance(before,payload['metadata'])
    for pipeline in payload['pipelines'].values():
        assert len(pipeline)==len(inputs)
        index={r['id']:r for r in pipeline}
        for item in inputs:assert index[item['id']]['pixelDigest']==item['pixelDigest']
    after=b.provenance(SOURCE,DATA,ROOT/'development-corpus.json',native,DATA/'third_party/research/WutheringWaves-Navigator',folder)
    assert before==after
    write(ROOT/f'replay-{name}-provenance.json',before)
    print(name,'native replay verified:',len(inputs),'inputs',flush=True)

"""Independent local experiment audit. Fails on leakage, label changes, or inconsistent metrics."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,pickle,re,sys,importlib.util
from collections import Counter
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OLD=ROOT.parent
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
manifest=read(ROOT/'coverage-manifest.json');rows=manifest['rows'];index={r['id']:r for r in rows}
session=[r for r in rows if not r['historical']];historical=[r for r in rows if r['historical']]
assert len(rows)==len(index)==1017
assert Counter(r['split'] for r in session)=={'train':731,'development':180,'purged':100}
assert all(r['expected']['x']<0 for r in session) and len(historical)==6
assert all(r['expected']['x']>0 and r['split']=='train' for r in historical)
assert not any(r['id'].endswith('-001100') for r in rows)
historical_original=read(SOURCE/'Tests/CoordinateOffline/corpus.json')
assert manifest['sources']['historicalCorpusSHA256']==sha(SOURCE/'Tests/CoordinateOffline/corpus.json')
historical_index={r['id']:r for r in historical_original['frames']}
for r in historical:
    assert r['expected']==historical_index[r['id']]['expected']
    assert r['annotation']==historical_index[r['id']]['annotation']
hist_eval=read(ROOT/'historical-evaluation-corpus.json')
assert {r['id'] for r in hist_eval['frames']}==set(historical_index)-{r['id'] for r in historical}
assert next(r for r in hist_eval['frames'] if r['id']=='user-grass')['expected']=={'x':229,'y':504,'z':None}
assert next(r for r in hist_eval['frames'] if r['id']=='user-snow')['state']=='unknown'
original=read(Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS\out\coordinate-expanded-study-20261015\training-prep-v1\manifest.json'))
original_index={r['id']:r for r in original['rows']}
assert manifest['sources']['captureManifestSHA256']==sha(Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS\out\coordinate-expanded-study-20261015\training-prep-v1\manifest.json'))
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np,paddle,yaml
paddle.set_device('cpu')
for r in rows:
    assert sha(Path(r['sourceImage']))==r['sourceSHA256']
    assert sha(Path(r['image']))==r['cropSHA256']
    a=np.array(Image.open(r['sourceImage']).convert('RGB'));x0,y0,x1,y1=r['sourceRect']
    assert np.array_equal(a[y0:y1,x0:x1],np.array(Image.open(r['image']).convert('RGB'))),r['id']
    if not r['historical']:
        assert r['text']==original_index[r['id']]['text'] and r['expected']==original_index[r['id']]['expected']
dev={r['id'] for r in rows if r['split']=='development'}
train={r['id'] for r in rows if r['split']=='train'}
assert not dev&train
for r in session:
    if r['split']=='train':assert all(abs(int(r['id'][-6:])-int(i[-6:]))>10 for i in dev)
train_reports=[]
before=paddle.load(str(OLD/'numeric-runtime-initial.pdparams'))
for name in ['coverage-only','coverage-positive']:
    t=manifest['trials'][name];assert t['entries']==1728
    ids=t['orderedIds'];assert set(ids)<=train and not set(ids)&dev
    assert {r['id'] for r in session if r['split']=='train'}<=set(ids)
    lines=(ROOT/(name+'.txt')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines();assert len(lines)==len(ids)
    for line,ident in zip(lines,ids):
        image,text=line.split('\t');assert Path(image)==Path(index[ident]['image']) and text==index[ident]['text']
    assert sum(index[i]['expected']['x']>0 for i in ids)==(128 if name=='coverage-positive' else 0)
    state=pickle.loads((ROOT/name/'latest.states').read_bytes())
    assert state['epoch']==5 and state['global_step']==535,state
    log=(ROOT/(name+'-train.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert 'frozen pretrained running statistics in 151 BN layers' in log
    assert not re.search(r'\bloss:\s*(?:nan|inf)\b',log,re.I)
    assert 'not matched with loaded params' not in log and 'not in model' not in log
    after=paddle.load(str(ROOT/name/'latest.pdparams'))
    assert set(after)==set(before) and len(after)==968
    assert all(np.isfinite(v.numpy()).all() for v in after.values())
    bn=[k for k in after if k.endswith(('._mean','._variance'))];assert len(bn)==302
    assert all(np.array_equal(after[k].numpy(),before[k].numpy()) for k in bn)
    changed=sum(not np.array_equal(after[k].numpy(),before[k].numpy()) for k in after if k not in bn)
    assert changed>0
    config=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/(name+'.yaml')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert config['Global']['pretrained_model']==str(OLD/'numeric-runtime-initial').replace('\\','/')
    assert config['Global']['epoch_num']==5 and config['Optimizer']['lr']['learning_rate']==1e-5
    folder=ROOT/(name+'-infer-paddle30');meta=yaml.safe_load((folder/'inference.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert meta['PostProcess']['character_dict']==(folder/'ppocr_keys.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    assert len(meta['PostProcess']['character_dict'])==14 and read(folder/'inference.json')['base_code']['version']==1
    assert [t['RecResizeImg']['image_shape'] for t in meta['PreProcess']['transform_ops'] if 'RecResizeImg' in t]==[[3,48,320]]
    train_reports.append({'name':name,'eligibleUniqueImages':len(set(ids)),'samplerEntries':1728,
        'positiveXSamplerEntries':t['positiveXEntries'],'epochs':5,'optimizerUpdates':535,'imagePresentations':8560,
        'unchangedBNBuffers':302,'finiteParameterEntries':968,'changedOtherEntries':changed,
        'weightsSHA256':sha(ROOT/name/'latest.pdparams'),'trainingLogSHA256':sha(ROOT/(name+'-train.log')),
        'inferenceFiles':{n:sha(folder/n) for n in ['inference.json','inference.pdiparams','inference.yml','ppocr_keys.txt']}})

# Check direct scorer independently with the established benchmark implementation for every native route.
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchmark',SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr/benchmark.py')
b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
corpus=read(ROOT/'development-corpus.json');inputs=read(ROOT/'replay-inputs.json')['inputs']
assert Counter(f['state'] for f in corpus['frames'])=={'present':180,'absent':141,'unknown':8}
assert {f['id'] for f in corpus['frames'] if f['state']=='present'}==dev
assert all('expected' not in i and 'state' not in i for i in inputs)
report=read(ROOT/'coverage-report.json');summary={(s['model'],s['mode'],s['group']):s for s in report['summary']}
verified=0
for model in ['initial','previous','coverage-only','coverage-positive']:
    path=ROOT/f'replay-{model}.json';raw=read(path)
    provenance=read(ROOT/f'replay-{model}-provenance.json');b.verify_native_provenance(provenance,raw['metadata'])
    _,scored=b.summarize(corpus,inputs,raw['pipelines'])
    for mode in raw['pipelines']:
        for group in ['all']+[g['group'] for g in manifest['groups']]:
            part=[r for r in scored if r['mode']==mode and (group=='all' or r['state']=='present' and index[r['id'].split('@')[0]]['sceneGroup']==group)]
            s=summary[(model,mode,group)]
            assert s['correct']==sum(r['exactXYZ'] is True for r in part)
            assert s['wrong']==sum(r['wrongXYZReturn'] is True for r in part)
            assert s['miss']==sum(r['abstained'] and r['state']=='present' for r in part)
            assert s['falsePositives']==sum(r['falsePositive'] is True for r in part)
        verified+=len(inputs)
yolo_folder=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS\out\coordinate-minimap-check\ocr-full-session')
yolo_inputs=[r for r in read(yolo_folder/'inputs.json')['inputs'] if r['sourceId'] in {f['id'] for f in corpus['frames']} and r['profile']=='upstream-band']
yolo_ids={r['id'] for r in yolo_inputs}
yolo_predictions=[r for r in read(yolo_folder/'yolo.json')['results'] if r['id'] in yolo_ids]
_,yolo_scored=b.summarize(corpus,yolo_inputs,{'yolo':yolo_predictions})
for group in ['all']+[g['group'] for g in manifest['groups']]:
    part=[r for r in yolo_scored if group=='all' or r['state']=='present' and index[r['id'].split('@')[0]]['sceneGroup']==group]
    s=summary[('yolo','yolo',group)]
    assert s['correct']==sum(r['exactXYZ'] is True for r in part)
    assert s['wrong']==sum(r['wrongXYZReturn'] is True for r in part)
    assert s['miss']==sum(r['abstained'] and r['state']=='present' for r in part)
    assert s['falsePositives']==sum(r['falsePositive'] is True for r in part)
verified_yolo=len(yolo_predictions)
for path,digest in read(Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS\out\coordinate-label-expansion-20261015\verification.json'))['sourceHashes'].items():
    assert sha(Path(path))==digest
for row in read(OLD/'source-tree.json')['files']:
    data=(OLD/'PaddleOCR-source'/row['path']).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha1(f'blob {len(data)}\0'.encode()+data).hexdigest()==row['sha']
historical_results=[]
for name in ['coverage-only','coverage-positive']:
    folder=ROOT/('historical-'+name);p=read(folder/'report.json')
    historical_inputs=read(folder/'inputs.json')['inputs']
    assert p['repeats']==3 and p['sourceFrameIds']==11
    assert {r['sourceId'] for r in historical_inputs}==set(historical_index)-{r['id'] for r in historical}
    raw=read(folder/'ppocr.json');b.verify_native_provenance(p['provenance'],raw['metadata'])
    summaries,samples=b.summarize(hist_eval,historical_inputs,raw['pipelines'])
    report_s={(s['profile'],s['mode']):s for s in p['summary']}
    for s in summaries:
        for k in ['xyCorrect','xyzCorrect','wrongXYReturns','wrongXYZReturns','falsePositives']:
            assert s[k]==report_s[(s['profile'],s['mode'])][k]
    historical_results.append({'model':name,'reportSHA256':sha(folder/'report.json'),
        'readoutLine':[{k:r.get(k) for k in ['id','mode','selected','expected','state','exactXY','exactXYZ']}
            for r in samples if r['id'] in ['user-grass@readout-line','user-snow@readout-line']
            and r['mode'] in ['ppocr-contrast-clock','ppocr-corroborated-clock']]})
result={'training':train_reports,'independentNativeFrameJudgments':verified,'independentYoloFrameJudgments':verified_yolo,'sourceAndLegacyLabelsUnchanged':True,
    'positiveHistoricalImages':6,'allTrainingCropsPixelVerified':1017,'developmentFrames':180,'purgedFrames':100,
    'reportSHA256':sha(ROOT/'coverage-report.json'),'newDownloadsBytes':0,'productionChanged':False,
    'historicalResults':historical_results,'independentAcceptance':False,
    'environmentWarning':'GPU cuDNN compile 9.9 vs available 9.5 remains; final replay uses CPU native library.'}
(ROOT/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

OUT=SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr/annotations/20261015-session-1F638949'

m=read(ROOT/'coverage-manifest.json');report=read(ROOT/'coverage-report.json');verification=read(ROOT/'verification.json')
split={g['group']:{s:[r['id'] for r in m['rows'] if r['sceneGroup']==g['group'] and r['split']==s]

unchangedFrozenBNWrapper.text:
"""Trial wrapper: preserve pretrained BN running statistics without editing upstream."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,sys,json
os.environ['NO_ALBUMENTATIONS_UPDATE']='1';os.environ['FLAGS_allocator_strategy']='auto_growth'
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'PaddleOCR-source'))
import paddle
import tools.train as trainer
import tools.program as program
original=trainer.build_model
def frozen_build(config):
    model=original(config);count=0
    for layer in model.sublayers():
        if isinstance(layer,(paddle.nn.BatchNorm1D,paddle.nn.BatchNorm2D,paddle.nn.BatchNorm3D)):
            layer._use_global_stats=True;count+=1
    assert count==151,('Unexpected BN count',count)
    print('TRIAL: frozen pretrained running statistics in',count,'BN layers; affine parameters remain trainable.',flush=True)
    return model
trainer.build_model=frozen_build
config,device,logger,writer=program.preprocess(is_train=True)
trainer.set_seed(config['Global']['seed'])
trainer.main(config,device,logger,writer)
